_extraction_flags.notes: Unified Waveform (QPSK-DSSS) for FSO-ISAC. Simulation under Gamma-Gamma turbulence.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: System Block Diagram (Tx: QPSK+PN -> Laser; Rx: Coherent Detection + MF). Fig 2: BER vs SNR. Fig 3: Ranging Profile.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: Proposed 'Unified Waveform' where user data (QPSK) is spread by PN sequence (DSSS) for Sensing. This is a classic DSSS-ISAC approach applied to Optical Wireless.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: BER improvement ~7.5 dB in moderate turbulence due to DSSS. Sensing: 100.011m ranging result.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Solid simulation paper. Demonstrates the dual benefit of DSSS: Ranging capability + Anti-jamming/Anti-turbulence for Comm.

bibliographic.title: A Unified Waveform for Optical Wireless Integrated Sensing and Communication

application.scenario_description: V2V / Autonomous vehicle scenario using ISAC for simultaneous data tx and ranging.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Proposal of QPSK-DSSS unified waveform for FSO-ISAC. Use of PN sequence for Ranging and spreading gain for Comm integrity under turbulence.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Providing simultaneous high-accuracy ranging and robust communication under atmospheric turbulence.

receiver.notes: Coherent detection with 2x4 90deg hybrid and BPDs.

waveform.notes: QPSK Symbols spread by PN sequence (DSSS).

comm_metrics.notes: Metrics relative to SNR. DSSS shows 1.5-7.5 dB SNR gain over uncoded QPSK.
